blocks.text: Hydrocarbons are produced naturally by vegetation, wildfires, volcanoes and seeps, and by human activities such as the incomplete burning of fossil fuels, oil spills and industrial and vehicle emissions; automobiles are the major source. Methane is the most common hydrocarbon air pollutant.

blocks.prompt: Name the main natural and human sources of hydrocarbons in the air, and the commonest hydrocarbon pollutant.
blocks.explanation: Natural: vegetation, wildfires, volcanoes and natural seeps of oil and gas. Human: incomplete burning of fossil fuels, oil spills, industrial and above all vehicle emissions. Methane is the commonest.

items: Hydrocarbons from vegetation, wildfire, volcanoes, seeps; incomplete combustion, oil spills, industry, vehicles (major); methane the commonest.
